anomalies.observed: The PWM selection 0 Ω jumpers (R16/R2 for one channel and R19/R11 for the other) feed NET0017 and NET0007, and those nets run directly to the servo-header signal pins (J2 pin 3 / J1 pin 3) and to the 0 Ω serial jumpers annotated 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo'. No 1 kΩ series resistor is shown in either PWM path; the only 1 kΩ resistor visible on the sheet (R24) is in the MAX3485/UART area, not in the PWM-to-servo-header path.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires R3 and R4, 1 kΩ each, in series from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to the servo header signal pins (J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3, corresponding to J2 pin 3 / J1 pin 3 in this drawing).

evidence.quote: R16 0, R2 0, R19 0, R11 0; 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo' (sheet 1, right side)
R3, R4 | 1k each | Series resistors from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3 respectively.

anomalies.impact: In PWM mode the M5Stack GPIOs drive the servo signal lines without the intended 1 kΩ current-limiting/buffering resistors, which can overload the GPIO or servo input and changes the board behavior from the intended design. In serial mode the bridge is also made on the un-buffered PWM nets.

parsed.summary: The schematic appears to omit the two 1 kΩ PWM series resistors specified for the servo signal paths, connecting the PWM nets directly to the servo headers and serial jumpers. This is a deviation from the intended design.
